policy.rule: Replicated attestations, phonological plausibility and source-compatible morphology do not become token-specific parse or cognacy without direct evidence.

modern_e_vowel_support: Márquez 1999 directly records the pastoral/care family nesema, nesbonama, nesame, neser, neserichi
Campos/Burgess 2004 Lowland Tarahumara title Tewé Ralámuli Chibá Neseme = girl who tends goats
Western/Lowland Tarahumara Bible replicates neseme in an animal-caretaker context
modern_i_vowel_support: Awilichi bawi contains nise’ami/niseami in a goat-herding narrative
morphological_support: Márquez grammar documents present participial -ame and derivational -me/-mi with participial function
Compendio básico de la gramática ralámuli 1997 documents regional -ame/-me participial/nominalizing morphology including -me in Baja-TB
phonological_support: Merrill documents historical e~i and é~í alternations but states they are limited and non-regular
Márquez also recognizes i~e alternation in the language
candidates.supports: Direct modern e-vowel pastoral family plus compatible regional participial morphology make the historical-modern comparison substantially stronger and non-ad-hoc.
candidates.does_not_support: An explicit token parse nesame/neseme = root + participial suffix, direct Nessé~nes-/Nisé cognacy, a universal e>i law, or independent-source counting for every attestation.
unresolved: full genealogy of modern lexicographic sources
candidates.remaining_A_requirement: Either a token-specific published morphological parse of nesame/neseme or a published direct identification of Nessé with nes-/Nisé as historical variants/cognates.

candidates.reason: Márquez partially depends on earlier lexicography and multiple Lowland/Western attestations share Burgess-associated editorial genealogy. Replication must be distinguished from independent evidence.

global_constraints: No universal e > i or é > í law.
No automatic segmentation nesame = nes + -ame without token-specific source evidence.
No automatic source-independence count from repeated attestations.
No automatic transfer of Tellechea preterite que/ca deletion to participles.
next_source_test: Seek only a token-specific morphological analysis of nesame/neseme or a published direct historical comparison Nessé~nes-/Nisé; otherwise retain C04 at B+ exceptional.
